data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by transient API errors (HTTP 400 for qwen, HTTP 429 for openrouter) preventing those models from completing their audits, rather than any actual security disagreement. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and found them safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to HTTP 400 error.

learnings: Transient API errors (400, 429) should trigger automatic retries rather than immediately failing the file audit and marking the package inconclusive.

Models correctly distinguish between packaging bugs (e.g., literal 'host-tuple' instead of a target triple) and actual security injections; this distinction should be reinforced in prompts to prevent false positives on sloppy packaging.
